1809-2225-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-2225-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

728-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
728-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

4694-5256-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5256-5805-7306.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-7889-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-7889-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-4476-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4476-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

225-2557-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1978-2347-5793-7008.description:
Activate Firemind Vessel by tapping it, adding two mana.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Firemind Vessel which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

4742-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4742-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4742-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2511-2525-3763-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2511-2525-3763-6749.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

765-1558-3875-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-3875-4231-4772.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3986-5223.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
3259-3986-5223.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4359-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4359-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1069-1374-5499-7060--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-5499-7060--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

3835-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-360-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-360-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-5205-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2350-3532-5078-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

465-2438-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2421-3375-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

104-3197-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-4268.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2511-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2178-2511-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

777-2866-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4067-5184-5742-5743.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

864-2034-2639-3254-4871.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-2034-2639-3254-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-2034-2639-3254-4871.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nethroi, adding {C}{C}.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Oozes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Oozes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3957-4395.notablePrerequisites:
Lightning Prowess attached to Famished Paladin.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
3957-4395.description:
Give Famished Paladin lifelink, if needed.
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

1102-2060-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Steel Overseer.
Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
1102-2060-4222.description:
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Steel Overseer.
Repeat.

273-1778-4763-5147.description:
Equip Memnite with Shuko.
Sacrifice Memnite to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Memnite to you hand.
Cast Memnite.
Repeat.

2018-4050-4053.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
2018-4050-4053.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature without flying, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
